name: intelligent-agent-identity-verification-system
description: Intelligent Agent Identity Verification System — root scripts for frontend, backend, and AI service

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm run install:ai
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:ai"
